lines.text: Many learners say: I like very much pizza.
Better: I like pizza very much.
Very much goes after the thing.
Football very much! I love football very much.

data.why: Very much goes after the thing.

native.tip: En français, « j'aime beaucoup la pizza ». En anglais, “very much” se place à la fin.
